# PRMB Cleaning

> PRMB Cleaning is a service-area cleaning company serving homes and businesses in Salt Lake City, Provo, Ogden, Park City, and nearby Utah communities. The company provides residential, commercial, deep, move-in/move-out, post-construction, window, event, garage, and recurring janitorial cleaning. Call or text (385) 314-9098 for a free quote.

## Services

- [House cleaning](https://prmbcleaning.com/services/house-cleaning): Recurring and one-time residential cleaning.
- [Commercial cleaning](https://prmbcleaning.com/services/commercial-cleaning): Cleaning for offices and other business spaces.
- [Deep cleaning](https://prmbcleaning.com/services/deep-cleaning): Detailed cleaning for built-up grime and hard-to-reach areas.
- [Move-in and move-out cleaning](https://prmbcleaning.com/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning): Cleaning for property transitions.
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://prmbcleaning.com/services/post-construction-cleaning): Fine-dust and residue cleaning after building or renovation work.
